skill.summary: Feishu Bitable Storage Manager - Integrated tool for item storage, retrieval, and location updates

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Storage Manager.

- Integrated with Feishu Bitable for smart item storage management.
- Supports adding, searching, and updating storage items and their locations.
- Command-line interface for easy item and location management.
- Requires Python 3.6+, requests library, and Feishu app credentials.
